description: The same Express, FastAPI and Flask auth routes logging the way the fix recommends: a masked email or the client IP on attempts/failures, the user id on success and on reset, and the error name on JWT failure. The words 'password' and 'token' appear only as prose inside the log message text — no password, token or header value is logged. Next.js middleware: logs the path and whether an Authorization header is present (`request.headers.has("authorization")`, a boolean), not the header. VC118 must not fire.
